    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    bg = Counter(v for row in grid for v in row).most_common(1)[0][0]

    seen = set()
    comps = []

                continue
            q = deque([(r, c)])

            cells = set()

                cells.add((y, x))
                for ny, nx in ((y-1,x), (y+1,x), (y,x-1), (y,x+1)):
                    if 0 <= ny < h and 0 <= nx < w and (ny, nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx] == color:
                        seen.add((ny, nx))
                        q.append((ny, nx))
            comps.append((color, cells))

    def bounds(cells):
        return min(r for r, c in cells), max(r for r, c in cells), min(c for r, c in cells), max(c for r, c in cells)

    def is_l(cells):
        r0, r1, c0, c1 = bounds(cells)
        if r0 == r1 or c0 == c1:
            return False
        shapes = [
            {(r0, c) for c in range(c0, c1+1)} | {(r, c0) for r in range(r0, r1+1)},
            {(r0, c) for c in range(c0, c1+1)} | {(r, c1) for r in range(r0, r1+1)},
            {(r1, c) for c in range(c0, c1+1)} | {(r, c0) for r in range(r0, r1+1)},
            {(r1, c) for c in range(c0, c1+1)} | {(r, c1) for r in range(r0, r1+1)},
        ]
        return any(cells == s for s in shapes)

    # The large L is the color cue; its corner determines which small
    # near-L object is recolored.
    templates = [(color, cells) for color, cells in comps if is_l(cells)]
    if not templates:
        return [row[:] for row in grid]
    marker_color, marker = max(templates, key=lambda x: len(x[1]))
    mr0, mr1, mc0, mc1 = bounds(marker)

    # Determine which corner of the cue is the bend.
    corners = [
        {(mr0, c) for c in range(mc0, mc1+1)} | {(r, mc0) for r in range(mr0, mr1+1)},
        {(mr0, c) for c in range(mc0, mc1+1)} | {(r, mc1) for r in range(mr0, mr1+1)},
        {(mr1, c) for c in range(mc0, mc1+1)} | {(r, mc0) for r in range(mr0, mr1+1)},
        {(mr1, c) for c in range(mc0, mc1+1)} | {(r, mc1) for r in range(mr0, mr1+1)},
    ]
    orient = next((i for i, s in enumerate(corners) if marker == s), 0)

    # Look for a compact object with the same L-corner orientation.
    candidates = []
    for color, cells in comps:
        if color == marker_color:
            continue
        r0, r1, c0, c1 = bounds(cells)
        if r0 == r1 or c0 == c1 or len(cells) < 3:
            continue
        ideal = [
            {(r0, c) for c in range(c0, c1+1)} | {(r, c0) for r in range(r0, r1+1)},
            {(r0, c) for c in range(c0, c1+1)} | {(r, c1) for r in range(r0, r1+1)},

        ]
        # Prefer the cue's orientation, allowing a small object to have a

            cues.append(comp)
